app.name: FlexcityHeadquarters
app.unknownOrg: We couldn't find this organization. Check the web address you were given.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email your organization has on file.
login.locked: Too many attempts. This account is locked for 15 minutes; reset your password to unlock it now.
login.tooMany: Too many sign-in attempts from this device. Wait a few minutes.

board.title: Shift board
board.assigned: Shift claimed. It's now on your schedule.
board.pendingApproval: This shift would add {{hours}} h of overtime, so it has been sent to a supervisor for approval.
board.alreadyClaimed: Someone else claimed this shift first.
board.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
board.description: Open shifts and shifts coworkers are giving away. You only see the ones you're qualified and available for.
board.emptyBody: When a shift opens up that you can work, it appears here and you get a notification.
board.notEligibleHelp: These rules protect you and the people in the water.

blocks.NOT_QUALIFIED_FOR_POSITION: You're not approved for this position.
blocks.CERTIFICATION_EXPIRES: A required certification expires before this shift ends.
blocks.PREREQUISITE_LAPSED: A prerequisite certification (e.g. first aid) has lapsed.
blocks.OVERLAPPING_SHIFT: You're already working during this time.
blocks.ON_APPROVED_TIME_OFF: You have approved time off during this shift.
blocks.REST_BETWEEN_SHIFTS: You wouldn't get the required rest between shifts.
blocks.DAILY_REST: You wouldn't get the required daily rest.
blocks.UNDER_MINIMUM_AGE: You're under the minimum age for this position.
blocks.YOUNG_WORKER_LIMIT: This would exceed young-worker hour limits.
blocks.OVER_PERSONAL_WEEKLY_MAX: This would exceed your weekly hour cap.

demo.banner: Demo with sample data — nothing you do here is saved.

common.error: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account uses that email, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.rule: Use at least 10 characters, mixing letters with numbers or symbols.
reset.weak: Use at least 10 characters, mixing letters with numbers or symbols.
reset.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one from the sign-in page.

notifications.shift_available: A shift you can take was posted to the board.
notifications.shift_assigned: A shift was added to your schedule.
notifications.shift_covered: Your shift was covered by a coworker.
notifications.shift_unassigned: You were taken off a shift.
notifications.shift_changed: One of your shifts changed time.
notifications.shift_cancelled: One of your shifts was cancelled.
notifications.schedule_published: Your new schedule is out: {{count}} shifts.
notifications.claim_needs_approval: A shift claim needs your approval ({{overtimeHours}} h overtime).
notifications.claim_pending: Your claim was sent to a supervisor because it adds {{overtimeHours}} h of overtime.
notifications.time_off_requested: A time-off request is waiting for you.
notifications.punch_rejected: A punch of yours needs correcting.
notifications.cert_to_verify: A certification is waiting to be verified.
notifications.closure_recommended: Closure recommended: a chemical reading is out of range.

today.noShiftsTitle: No shifts in the next two weeks
today.noShiftsBody: Pick up open shifts from the board, or check back after the next schedule is published.
today.clockHint: Clock in when your shift starts

schedule.title: My schedule
schedule.description: Your shifts for the next four weeks, in each facility's local time.
schedule.posted: Posted to the shift board. You stay responsible until someone takes it.
schedule.emptyBody: Shifts appear here once a supervisor publishes the schedule.

errors.SHIFT_ALREADY_CLAIMED: Someone else took this shift first.
errors.SHIFT_CHANGED: This shift just changed. Refresh to see the latest.
errors.ALREADY_POSTED: This shift is already on the board.
errors.SHIFT_NOT_PUBLISHED: Only published shifts can go on the board.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to do that.
errors.VALIDATION: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.
errors.TIME_OFF_OVERLAPS: You already asked for time off during part of these days.
errors.ALREADY_STARTED: This time off has started. Ask your supervisor to change it.

timeclock.title: Timeclock
timeclock.description: Clock in when your shift starts and out when it ends. Your supervisor reviews punches before payroll.
timeclock.unscheduled: Clock in without a scheduled shift
timeclock.unscheduledHelp: For call-ins and cover. Your supervisor will review it.
timeclock.locationNote: When you clock in we check, once, that you're at the facility. We don't track your location.
timeclock.noPunches: No punches in the last two weeks.

location.OUTSIDE_RADIUS: Clocked in. You seem to be away from the facility, so your supervisor will check this punch.
location.LOW_ACCURACY: Clocked in. Your location was unclear, so your supervisor will check this punch.
location.NO_LOCATION: Clocked in without location. Your supervisor will check this punch.

timeOff.title: Time off
timeOff.description: Ask for time away. If it's approved, your shifts in that time go to the board for others to cover.
timeOff.emptyBody: Requests you send appear here with their answer.
timeOff.protectedHint: You're entitled to this leave under employment standards. You don't need to share medical details.
timeOff.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: When you can work each week. The scheduling assistant only offers you shifts inside these times.
availability.effectiveHint: Earlier weeks keep your old availability.
availability.endBeforeStart: Each time must end after it starts.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.description: Take attendance on the deck. It saves on your phone first and uploads when there's signal.
lessons.offline: You're offline. Showing rosters saved at {{time}}. Your marks will upload when you reconnect.
lessons.emptyTitle: No lessons in the next week
lessons.emptyBody: Classes appear here when you're scheduled as the instructor.
